full.description: This image is a gross pathology photograph showing a small, well-circumscribed tissue specimen measured against a metric scale. The specimen has a smooth, lobulated surface with yellowish and brownish-red areas characteristic of an endocrine lesion. Based on the appearance and size, this represents a benign cortical nodule or adenoma of the adrenal gland. Such nodules are frequently incidental findings composed of hyperplastic or neoplastic adrenal cortical tissue.

random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a surgically excised tissue specimen placed against a metric ruler for scale. The specimen appears to be a thyroid nodule or gland fragment measuring approximately one to two centimeters in greatest dimension. The surface is smooth, lobulated, and has a brownish-pink coloration with some attached soft tissue at the base. These findings are characteristic of thyroid nodular hyperplasia.
